tiers.name: ULTRA MEGA
tiers.note: body HP ×15.84, then the night's ×0.25 (yetis) · ×0.5 (snowmen, pigs); the three bosses' bars flat for any party since v29.45 (Sergeant Cold 9,000 · Sergeant Snowman 10,000 · King Yeti 17,000); the home turret and the new guns are off on this tier (the heavies standing the rolling ball and the snowball tripping mines too): the old guns, one KO a bolt every 2.2 s

damageLaw: Since v29.70 no hit in the Ice Castle is an instant KO: every hit that was one (the yetis' pounce, Sergeant Cold's big snowball, sprint and leap, Sergeant Snowman's rolling ball on a light man, every move King Yeti has, THEIR ULTRA MEGA bolt) takes a priced bite: no instant KO since v29.70: 0.9 × the M. gunner's sheet HP at the chart's rank for the castle (rank 31: 30 HP; MEGA and ULTRA MEGA rank 54: 40 HP) × the castle's 0.6 · 0.6 · 0.65 · 0.9 on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA (since v31.00) × MEGA's 1.2 = 16.2 · 16.2 · 17.55 · 38.88 · 43.2 HP (E · M · H · G · U), landing whole (the damper does not take it), as bar hits = that × bar ÷ HP; a rifleman falls to one, any other man stands his first from a full bar on 15 % of it on EASY to MEGA (no single hit fells him) and the next fells him; ULTRA MEGA has no such floor; one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (EASY to MEGA). Three hits take part of a man, each landing at 50 % under the damper since v29.17: the snowman's thrown ball (2 bar hits, MEGA and ULTRA MEGA ×1.2, at the damper 1 · 1.2, landing 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP of that), THEIR turret on EASY to MEGA (0.625 · 0.75 · 0.875 · 1.2 HP a round, a fifth on a heavy) and Sergeant Snowman's ball on a heavy (25 % of his bar, MEGA 30 %). Difficulty changes the bite, the bodies, the head-counts and the clocks.
headlines: No instant KO since v29.70: the yetis' pounce, Sergeant Cold's big snowball, sprint and (MEGA / ULTRA MEGA) purple leap, Sergeant Snowman's rolling ball on a light man, every move of King Yeti's and THEIR ULTRA MEGA bolt take a priced bite of 16.2 · 16.2 · 17.55 · 38.88 · 43.2 HP (E · M · H · G · U). A level-25 rifleman still falls to one; any other man stands his first from a full bar on 15 % on EASY to MEGA (since v31.00); the bazooka and the flame stand three or four bites on EASY, two on MEGA.

Three hits take part of a man, each landing at 50 % under the damper since v29.17 (50 % off every bar hit and HP hit on your men; the priced bite lands whole): the snowman's thrown ball (2 bar hits, MEGA / ULTRA MEGA ×1.2, landing as 1 · 1.2; 20 % / 40 % slower fire a ball up to 90 %, the M. gunner ×1.2); THEIR turret on EASY to MEGA (0.625 · 0.75 · 0.875 · 1.2 HP a round as it lands on E · M · H · G, a heavy a fifth: a level-25 rifleman falls in 3.6 s, a flame in 75 s on EASY); Sergeant Snowman's ball on a heavy (25 % of his bar, MEGA 30 %: 4 volleys in a row KO him).

The saber Sarge turns about 75 % of the priced bites at rank 25 (his 50 % block rolls twice: measured 28–33 of 40 pounces a tier on Chrome, 29–32 on WebKit) and some turret rounds. The hero kings (King Yeti, King Rex) bounce thrown and rolling snowballs; every hero stands the priced bite (a deep bar); King Croak was never touched by a snowman's ball in 5 s (measured, not a law).

King Yeti since Nov 5 and v32.28: on EASY to MEGA his red seize (8 s) and blue wind (10 s) and four more crystals each run on their own cooldown and go only at a man in reach; he hops every 10 s; one wind reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (measured over six); his piggy flood (10 · 10 · 11 · 17 · 20 pigs) rises at the right edge of the map.
The mine: Sergeant Snowman's rolling ball trips your charge on EASY to MEGA, the ball bursts and a rifleman 65 px off falls to the full blast (v28.81); ULTRA MEGA rolls over it.

Difficulty changes the bodies (×1 · ×1.5 · ×2.2 · ×2.64 · ×15.84, ULTRA MEGA then the night's ×0.25 yetis · ×0.5 snowmen, pigs and sergeants · ×0.6048 the king), the head-counts (217 · 217 · 322 · 357 · 161 bodies solo, the three bosses not counted) and the clocks (King Yeti's snowball every 2.6 · 2.08 · 1.35 · 1.35 · 1.35 s); the priced bite grows with the tier.

changes.title: RAZIYA'S BOSS NOTES: THE CASTLE AND EVERY BOSS FIGHT
changes.what: THE CASTLE: a former KO costs × 0.6 · 0.6 · 0.65 · 0.9 here (E · M · H · G: 16.2 · 16.2 · 17.55 · 32.4 HP before MEGA's 1.2), snowmen, pigs and big yetis wear × 1.3 · 1.3 · 1.5 · 2 HP, King Yeti's summons × 0.5 · 0.5 · 0.55 · 0.85 (pigs 10 · 10 · 11 · 17, was 20; munchkins 5 · 5 · 6 · 9, was 10) rising behind him, details walk with both sergeants, our gun does half to snowmen and pigs, Sergeant Snowman's stomp is a shove, his big hop waits for his wave. EVERY BOSS FIGHT: no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar (he stands on 15 % of it, the next fells him) and one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (measured: one blue wind over six men struck 3 · 4 · 4 · 5). ULTRA MEGA reads none of it.

changes.title: ISAAC'S THREE (v30.11) + ROUNDS 2-4 (v30.28 · v30.32 · v30.38)
changes.what: EASY to MEGA: the turrets throw snowballs from a pile (the same rounds), Sergeant Snowman hops at your toy box (30 m first, then 3-30 m every 7.5 s, never nearer than 30 m), Sergeant Cold × 0.6 and Sergeant Snowman × 0.9 on EASY and MEDIUM; King Yeti's red seize and blue wind leave the wheel for a power clock and go only at a man in reach, he deals the hero's crystals but purple, and he hops every 10 s (every third a saber bounce from man to man). Measured: his hop restarts his snowball's clock (the first big snowball came at 5.2 s, not 2.6, on EASY and MEDIUM until the hop was held).

changes.title: NO INSTANT KO (ISAAC'S PASS)
changes.what: Every hit that was a KO (the pounce, the big snowballs, the sprint, the leaps, Sergeant Snowman's ball on a light man, every move of King Yeti's, THEIR ULTRA MEGA bolt) takes 0.9 × the M. gunner's sheet HP at the chart's rank for the castle's level (55 → rank 31: 30 HP; MEGA and ULTRA MEGA 95 → rank 54: 40 HP) off his sheet, landing whole (the damper does not take it; MEGA's +20 % on top): today 16.2 · 16.2 · 17.55 · 38.88 · 43.2 HP. A bite that empties his bar still fells him. THE HEAVY CLASS: the bazooka, flame and commando read at least twice the M. gunner's HP (level 25: bazooka 50 HP, commando 50, flame 55), so their turret needs more rounds on them. Measured on seven men a tier, both engines; the saber Sarge turns about 75 % (measured Chrome 31 · 33 · 31 · 28 · 30, WebKit 32 · 29 · 31 · 30 · 31 of 40 pounces on the five tiers).

changes.title: ULTRA MEGA HP: THE NIGHT KINGS' BARS FLAT FOR ANY PARTY
changes.what: ULTRA MEGA: the three bosses' bars no longer grow with the commanders in the fight: Sergeant Cold 9,000, Sergeant Snowman 10,000, King Yeti 17,000 with one commander and with ten (the +3,000 with 3 commanders went with it). Sergeant Snowman hops toward your men there (the first 12 s after he steps on, then every 24 s; the landing takes the priced bite off the men within 48 px; not in this proof). EASY to MEGA keep the party law.

changes.title: READ AGAIN ON v29.45
changes.what: Read again on v29.45 after the day's cards: the three bosses' bars for one commander on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD follow the designers' time-to-kill chart (CARD-RXT, v29.37: King Yeti 2,029 · 2,705 · 4,058, the sergeants in step) and on MEGA the player-damage-threshold pass's number (CARD-PDT: King Yeti 4,860); the men's tenth-rank HP moved (CARD-FLT, v29.40: the flame's rungs through level 50 tripled; CARD-DHP, v29.41: the bazooka's and commando's doubled): at level 25 the flame 55 HP, the bazooka 33, the commando 41 WHO SURVIVES and THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES count it.

changes.title: THE DAMPER
changes.what: Every enemy blow on your men lands at 50 % in the campaign and the boss fights: 50 % off every bar hit and HP hit, one row in THE BOSS LAB's RULES (THE DAMPER, a cell a tier). In the castle three hits take part of a man and all three land at 50 %: the snowman's ball (a level-25 rifleman takes 0.94 of his 6 bar hits on EASY, was 1.89), THEIR turret's round (0.625 HP on EASY, was 1.25: a lone level-25 rifleman now falls in 3.6 s, a flame in 75.5 s, measured) and Sergeant Snowman's ball on a heavy (25 % of his bar, was 50 %: 4 volleys in a row KO him). A KO is not a hit: every KO strike in this fight lands as before.

changes.title: KING YETI'S TURRETS
changes.what: EASY to MEGA: the home post on the road by your toy box starts neutral like the two in the middle (it started OURS); a side that holds its ring alone 3 s takes it. A boss alone in a ring now takes a post like any yeti (the ring skipped every boss). The castle's posts lost their flag pole.

changes.title: KING YETI'S FIELD
changes.what: EASY to MEGA: a third turret, OURS from the whistle, on the road by your toy box. Both sides' guns fire a 3-round burst every 0.5 s. THEIR gun stops being a KO: a round takes 1.25 · 1.5 · 1.75 · 2 HP (E · M · H · G, MEGA ×1.2 on top), a fifth of that on the bazooka, grenadier, flame and commando. OUR gun does half to the big yeti, the sergeants and the king. Sergeant Snowman's ball takes half a heavy's bar instead of a KO. A rolling snowball sets off your charges. ULTRA MEGA is not in it.

changes.title: ROUND 2 · THE FULL BLAST
changes.what: A charge a snowball sets off blasts your own men too, the campaign's own friendly fire (Wyatt: "Full blast with friendly fire"). Measured: a rifleman 65 px from the charge was KO'd on every tier.

changes.title: THE HEAVIES
changes.what: +3 HP every tenth rank for the bazooka, grenadier, flame and commando. At level 25: bazooka 50, grenadier 22, flame 55, commando 50 HP. THEIR turret and (since v29.70) the priced bite read this HP (the numbers are today's, the heavy class of v29.70 inside).

changes.title: THE BOMBER
changes.what: Your bomber flies in every boss fight now, the castle included, and aims at the thickest knot of yetis (or the boss).

changes.title: ONE HP NUMBER
changes.what: Your man's HP is the number on his unit sheet. A snowman's ball still counts in bar hits, but lands a little lighter on tough men: 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP (a level-25 flame takes 1.82 of 2, a rifleman 1.89; before the damper).

changes.title: THE BOSS LAB'S STOCK ARMY
changes.what: The lab fights King Yeti with its own army at LEVEL 25 (the lab's stock level): the one this breakdown reads.

changes.title: HIS FORCE POWERS (a read, no change)
changes.what: King Yeti's seize and blue wind are ON at every tier. The fight hides them (half his seizes find nobody within 300 px, his snowball often KOs the man he holds, his sword swings at air between 64 and 130 px). Its fixes wait on Wyatt's KYP-Q1..Q4.

changes.title: UNCHANGED SINCE v29.45
changes.what: As read in v32.45: the snowman's ball, THEIR turret's round on EASY to MEGA, Sergeant Snowman's ball on a heavy, the damper, King Yeti's bar, the ULTRA MEGA night's rows.
